title: Practice: changing the subject
intro: Ten questions. When you type a rearranged formula you can include the subject (e.g. t = (5m + 1)/6) or just the right-hand side — both are marked.

hints: The machine is $x \to \times m \to \div c \to y$. Run it backwards.

questions.prompt: Put these steps in order to make $r$ the subject of $V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h$.

items.text: Multiply both sides by 3: $3V = \pi r^2 h$
Divide both sides by $\pi h$: $\frac{3V}{\pi h} = r^2$

hints: Undo the last thing that was done to $r$ first — the $\frac{1}{3}$ is the outermost operation.
questions.explanation: Forwards, $r$ is squared, multiplied by $\pi h$, then divided by 3. Backwards you undo those in reverse: $\times 3$, $\div \pi h$, then $\sqrt{\ }$.

hints: Then add $x$ to both sides so it is positive.
questions.explanation: $\frac{M}{4} = t - x \Rightarrow \frac{M}{4} + x = t \Rightarrow x = t - \frac{M}{4}$. Equivalent forms like $\frac{4t - M}{4}$ are also correct.

questions.prompt: Rearrange one step at a time.

steps.feedback: That leaves $g - y = \frac{f}{x}$ — the fraction on its own.

options.text: Multiply both sides by $x$: $x(g - y) = f$

steps.feedback: Multiplying by $x$ lifts it out of the denominator.

steps.prompt: Divide both sides by $(g - y)$. Type the formula for $x$.
steps.hint: Keep $g - y$ together in brackets when you divide by it.

questions.explanation: $g - y = \frac{f}{x} \Rightarrow x(g - y) = f \Rightarrow x = \frac{f}{g - y}$. The long fraction line then acts as the bracket.

hints: Dividing by $\frac{2}{5}$ is the same as multiplying by $\frac{5}{2}$.

questions.prompt: The area of a circle is $A = \pi r^2$. Make $r$ the subject.
hints: Type a square root as sqrt( … ) and $\pi$ as pi.

questions.prompt: Derive a formula, then use it.
questions.scenario: A rectangle is $(2x + 4)$ cm long and 7 cm wide. Its area is $A\ \text{cm}^2$.

steps.prompt: Rearrange to make $x$ the subject. Type the right-hand side using $A$.
Find $x$ when the area is 63 cm².
What is the length of the rectangle?

questions.explanation: $A = 14x + 28$, so $x = \frac{A - 28}{14}$. With $A = 63$, $x = 2.5$ and the length is $2(2.5) + 4 = 9$ cm.

questions.prompt: $V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h$. Find $r$ when $h = 2.1$ cm and $V = 100\ \text{cm}^3$. Take $\pi = 3.142$ and give your answer to 2 decimal places.
The swing time of a pendulum is $T = 2\pi\sqrt{\frac{l}{g}}$, which rearranges to $l = \left(\frac{T}{2\pi}\right)^2 g$. Find $l$ when $T = 1.571$ and $g = 32$. Take $\pi = 3.142$.
Make $x$ the subject of $y = r(x - s) + t$.
hints: Subtract $t$, then divide by $r$, then add $s$.
questions.explanation: $y - t = r(x - s) \Rightarrow \frac{y - t}{r} = x - s \Rightarrow x = \frac{y - t}{r} + s$.
